name: Chuanqilong
isnote: Described as a basal ankylosaurid (Han et al. 2014); it shows many similarities with Liaoningosaurus and may be a later growth stage of it (cited revision).
sum: Chuanqilong is a medium-sized ankylosaur from the Jiufotang Formation of Liaoning, China, described from a nearly complete juvenile skeleton.
wsnote: Estimate for the immature holotype; it may have been larger (cited Wikipedia revision).
holotype: CJPM V001, a nearly complete skull and skeleton of a juvenile lacking the distal tail — Jiufotang Formation, Liaoning.
biology: Triangular skull with neck armour; known from a juvenile.
author: Han et al. 2014
